name: Smith Machine Upright Row
steps: Face the Smith bar at thigh height and take a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Release the hooks and stand tall with your arms straight.
Pull the bar straight upward close to your torso by leading with your elbows out and up until they reach roughly shoulder height.
Lower the bar slowly back down to full arm extension under full control.
tips: Keep your wrists below your elbows and stop before you feel any shoulder pinching.
Avoid leaning back or bouncing at your knees to start the pull.
